summary: Leeds Bradford airspace deactivated overnight, with the aerodrome closed and no air traffic control service, Monday to Friday 2300 to 0600.
text:
LEEDS BRADFORD CTA, CTR, ATZ DEACTIVATED, AD CLOSED, NO ATC
SERVICE AVAILABLE. SUITABLY EQUIPPED ACFT WI LEEDS BRADFORD AIRSPACE 
DURING THESE PERIODS SHOULD MONITOR LEEDS RADAR ON CH 134.580 AND 
SQUAWK EITHER 2677, ANY DISCRETE TASK SPECIFIC CODE, OR ANY DISCRETE 
CODE ALLOCATED BY ANOTHER UNIT. MET OBSERVATIONS UNVERIFIED.
